Saturday basketball for kids in Copenhagen

One hour on Saturday morning in central Copenhagen for ages 5 to 12. Parents join for the last 20 minutes.

When
Saturdays 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By
Who
Kids 5 to 12, and parents for the last 20 minutes
Where
Kulturhuset Indre By, Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3, 1359 København K
Price
Mini and Junior membership, 1.800 kr per half-season
Book a trial

Saturday mornings

Our weekday sessions start at 15:30, which is hard when both parents work. Enough families told us, so we added Saturday mornings in the centre of town. No rush from school, no leaving work early, and you are done before lunch.

Schedule

11:00 to 11:40
Kids, ages 5 to 12. Fundamentals, small sided games and a lot of shots. When the group is big we split the younger and older kids on court. Most of them have never played before.
11:40 to 12:00
Family Time. Parents come on court and play with their kids. All levels. Grown ups need no experience. If you are new in Copenhagen, it is an easy way in for the whole family.

Two kids, one trip. A seven year old and an eleven year old play in the same hour.

We take a break on 26 December and 2 January.

Coaches

Tyler and Alex coach every Saturday, Family Time included. Deng is on the floor too.

Meet the coaches

Where

Kulturhuset Indre By
Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3, 1359 København K

Central and easy on public transport, a short walk from Nørreport. Bring indoor shoes and a water bottle. We bring the balls.

Questions

Is there a Saturday session for my 7-year-old?

Yes. Saturday is one session for kids 5 to 12, 11:00 to 12:00 at Kulturhuset Indre By.

Can we start a week later?

Yes. Pick any Saturday that suits you. We take a break on 26 December and 2 January.

Where is it, and how do we get there?

Kulturhuset Indre By, Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3, 1359 København K. It is a short walk from Nørreport. Bring indoor shoes and a water bottle.

Can my child try before we pay?

Yes. The first session is free. Book it below and you see the next Saturday session straight away.

Can I play with my child?

Yes. The last 20 minutes of every Saturday session are Family Time. Parents come on court with their kids. All levels, grown ups need no experience.

Book a trial

Your first session is free. Fill this in and you see the next Saturday session straight away. We email it too.
